Name: The Stank Face Round
Description:
Google's AI Overview defines Stank Face as:
an involuntary, positive facial expression where a person scrunches their nose, squints their eyes, and twists their mouth into a frown. People make this face when they hear an incredible bassline, a dirty guitar riff, or a heavy beat in genres like funk, jazz, and hip-hop, meaning the music is so good it feels "nasty" or "funky" in a great way.
